description: Creates and manages a simulated ledger environment for tests, allowing creation and funding of accounts, submission and processing of transactions, advancing ledger closes, and inspection of ledger state.
Represents a ledger account in tests, encapsulating account name and providing identity for test operations.
Funds one or more accounts with a specified amount of XRP in the test environment.
Establishes a trust line between two accounts for a specified IOU amount in the test environment.
Sends a payment from one account to another for a specified amount (XRP or IOU) in the test environment.
Sets account flags or properties (such as RequireAuth) for a given account in the test environment.
Checks or sets specific account flags for an account in the test environment.
Asserts that the ledger state matches expected conditions (such as balances, flags, or offers) after transactions are processed.
Enables or disables specific protocol amendments or features in the test environment.
Base class for all test suites, providing mechanisms for defining, running, and reporting test cases, as well as assertion helpers.
Macro to register a test suite with the test framework, specifying suite name, module, and library.
Entry point for executing all test cases in a suite; typically overridden to call individual test case functions.
Assertion macro to check a test condition and report pass or fail with file and line information.
Used within test cases to assert that certain ledger conditions hold after actions are performed.
Defines an individual test case within a suite, used for organizing and reporting test results.
Marks a test assertion as passed and notifies the test runner.
Marks a test assertion as failed, records the reason, and notifies the test runner.
Checks a condition and calls pass or fail accordingly, optionally with a reason and file/line info.
Checks that a function throws an exception as expected, marking the test as passed or failed.
Checks that a function does not throw an exception, marking the test as passed or failed.
Helper for managing the scope and reporting of individual test cases within a suite.
Helper for defining and managing test case names and abort behavior within a suite.
Returns the global list of registered test suites for the test framework.
Registers a new test suite with the global suite list, including metadata such as name, module, library, manual flag, and priority.
Adds a test suite to the suite list, ensuring uniqueness and storing suite metadata.
Creates a suite_info object for a test suite, encapsulating its metadata and run logic.
Executes a test suite or a range of suites, managing test case lifecycle events and result tracking.
Marks the start of a test case, triggering reporting and result tracking.
Records a test assertion as passed and updates test results.
Records a test assertion as failed, with an optional reason, and updates test results.
Records a log message for the current test case.
A test runner that collects and stores test results, including passes, failures, and logs, for later reporting.
Returns the collected test results from the recorder.
Handles the start of a test suite, initializing result tracking for the suite.
Handles the end of a test suite, finalizing and storing suite results.
Handles the start of a test case, initializing result tracking for the case.
Handles the end of a test case, finalizing and storing case results.
Records a test assertion as passed in the current case.
Records a test assertion as failed in the current case, with a reason.
Records a log message for the current test case.
Represents the results of a single test case, including pass/fail status and log messages.
Aggregates results from multiple test cases within a suite, tracking total and failed tests.
Aggregates results from multiple test suites, tracking overall statistics for all tests run.
Marks a test as passed within a case.
Marks a test as failed within a case, recording the reason.
Adds a case_results object to the suite, updating totals and failures.
Adds a suite_results object to the overall results, updating totals and failures.
